speaker: Doctor
text: I understand your urgency; given your history of AIDS and Kaposi's sarcoma, combined with painless vision loss and black spots, I suspect ocular involvement from cytomegalovirus (CMV) retinitis. DIAGNOSIS READY: CMV Retinitis
